title: Scriptaxy Core
description: Scriptaxy-Core is the all-in-one Minecraft server management solution with home systems, PvP controls, admin GUIs, and seamless plugin integrations.
body:
# Scriptaxy-Core
**Professional Minecraft Server Management Solution**

[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20+-4C566A?style=flat-square&logo=minecraft&logoColor=white)](https://minecraft.net) [![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-17+-D08770?style=flat-square&logo=openjdk&logoColor=white)](https://openjdk.org)
---

## Why Choose Scriptaxy-Core?

Transform your Minecraft server into a professional, feature-rich experience with Scriptaxy-Core. This comprehensive server management ecosystem is designed by experienced developers for modern server operations.

**All-in-One Solution • Lightning Fast Performance • Easy Setup**

---

## Core Features

### Player Management Systems
- **Multi-Home System** - Configurable home limits with cross-world support
- **Advanced TPA System** - Teleport requests with timeout and economy integration  
- **Nickname System** - Custom player nicknames with full color support
- **AFK Detection** - Intelligent tracking with configurable timeout settings
- **Player Statistics** - Comprehensive playtime, death, and activity analytics

### PvP & World Management
- **Smart PvP Control** - Granular per-player and per-world PvP settings
- **Safe Zones** - Protected areas with customizable boundaries for new players
- **World-Specific Rules** - Independent configuration for different world environments
- **Combat Protection** - Anti-logout protection with configurable combat timers

### Administrative Tools
- **GUI Management System** - Intuitive interfaces for all administrative tasks
- **MOTD Management** - Multi-line server messages with template system and live preview
- **Maintenance Mode** - Professional server maintenance with custom messaging
- **Database Management** - Built-in optimization tools and maintenance utilities
- **Backup System** - Automated backups with compression and scheduling options
- **Performance Monitor** - Real-time TPS, memory usage, and server health tracking

### Plugin Integrations
- **Vault Integration** - Complete economy support for teleportation costs and premium features
- **WorldGuard Support** - Region protection and safe teleportation validation
- **PlaceholderAPI** - 15+ custom placeholders for seamless integration with other plugins

---

## Administrative Interface

Professional server management through comprehensive GUI system:

- **MOTD Manager** - Template system with live preview and configuration controls
- **Player Hub** - Complete player management and statistical overview
- **World Control** - Per-world settings and spawn point management
- **Database Tools** - Real-time statistics and optimization utilities
- **System Monitor** - Live server performance and resource monitoring

---

## Installation & Setup

### System Requirements
- Minecraft 1.20 or higher
- Spigot/Paper server environment
- Java 17 or higher
- Approximately 5 minutes configuration time

### Installation Process
1. Download ScriptaxyCore.jar from Modrinth
2. Place the file in your server's `plugins/` directory  
3. Restart your server (configuration files will auto-generate)
4. Execute `/admin` to access the administrative control panel
5. Begin managing your server with enhanced tools

---

## Command Reference

### Player Commands
```
/home [name] - Teleport to your home
/sethome [name] - Set a new home location
/delhome <name> - Delete an existing home
/homes - View all your homes
/tpa <player> - Send teleport request
/tpaccept - Accept teleport request
/tpdeny - Deny teleport request
/nick <nickname> - Set your nickname
/afk - Toggle AFK status
/pvp - Toggle your PvP status
/spawn - Teleport to server spawn
```

### Admin Commands
```
/admin - Open the admin GUI
/setmotd <message> - Set server MOTD
/maintenance - Toggle maintenance mode
/backup - Create server backup
/dbmaint - Database maintenance
/reload - Reload configuration
```

---

## PlaceholderAPI Integration

**Available Placeholders (15+ custom placeholders):**

```
%scriptaxy_player_homes% - Home count
%scriptaxy_player_nickname% - Display name
%scriptaxy_player_pvp% - PvP status
%scriptaxy_player_afk% - AFK status
%scriptaxy_player_playtime% - Total playtime
%scriptaxy_server_tps% - Current TPS
%scriptaxy_server_players% - Online count
%scriptaxy_maintenance_status% - Maintenance mode
%scriptaxy_player_balance% - Balance (Vault)
```

---

## Configuration

### Database Setup (Zero Configuration Required)
```yaml
database:
  type: "sqlite"  # Works out-of-the-box!
  file: "data.db"
  auto-create: true
```

### MOTD Configuration
```yaml
server:
  motd-enabled: true
  motd:
    - "&6&lMyServer &8- &7Welcome!"
    - "&aJoin us for epic adventures!"
```

### Plugin Integration
```yaml
integrations:
  vault:
    enabled: true
    teleport-cost: 100
  worldguard:
    enabled: true
    safe-teleport: true
  placeholderapi:
    enabled: true
```
